salesforceExclusionReason: Schema.describeTabs is permission-gated in the target scratch org; this fixture proves deterministic local presentation metadata and makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.

source.content: List<Schema.DescribeTabSetResult> tabSets = Schema.describeTabs(); System.assert(tabSets.size() >= 1); Schema.DescribeTabSetResult tabSet = null; for (Schema.DescribeTabSetResult candidateTabSet : tabSets) { if (candidateTabSet.getTabSetId() == 'AllTabs') { tabSet = candidateTabSet; break; } } System.assertNotEquals(null, tabSet); System.assert(tabSet.equals(tabSet)); System.assert(!tabSet.equals(null)); System.assert(tabSet.hashCode() != 0); System.assert(tabSet.toString().contains('AllTabs')); System.assertEquals('All Tabs', tabSet.getLabel());  System.assertNotEquals(null, tabSet.getName()); System.assert(tabSet.getName().length() > 0); System.assertEquals('All Tabs', tabSet.getDescription()); System.assertEquals(null, tabSet.getLogoUrl()); System.assertEquals(null, tabSet.getNamespace()); System.assertEquals('AllTabs', tabSet.getTabSetId()); System.assert(!tabSet.isSelected()); System.assertEquals(tabSet.getDescription(), tabSet.description); System.assertEquals(tabSet.getLabel(), tabSet.label); System.assertEquals(tabSet.getName(), tabSet.name); System.assertEquals(tabSet.getLogoUrl(), tabSet.logoUrl); System.assertEquals(tabSet.getNamespace(), tabSet.namespace); System.assertEquals(tabSet.isSelected(), tabSet.selected); System.assertEquals(tabSet.getTabSetId(), tabSet.tabSetId); List<Schema.DescribeTabResult> tabs = tabSet.getTabs(); System.assert(tabs.size() >= 1); Schema.DescribeTabResult tab = null; for (Schema.DescribeTabResult candidate : tabs) { if (candidate.getName() == 'Widget__c') { tab = candidate; } } System.assertNotEquals(null, tab); List<Schema.DescribeColorResult> colors = tab.getColors(); System.assertEquals(1, colors.size()); Schema.DescribeColorResult color = colors.get(0); System.assert(color.equals(color)); System.assert(!color.equals(null)); System.assert(color.hashCode() != 0); System.assert(color.toString().contains('Custom42')); System.assertEquals('#747474', color.getColor()); System.assertEquals('primary', color.getContext()); System.assertEquals('Custom42: Treasure chest', color.getTheme()); System.assertEquals(color.getColor(), color.color); System.assertEquals(color.getContext(), color.context); System.assertEquals(color.getTheme(), color.theme); List<Schema.DescribeIconResult> icons = tab.getIcons(); System.assertEquals(1, icons.size()); Schema.DescribeIconResult icon = icons.get(0); System.assert(icon.equals(icon)); System.assert(!icon.equals(null)); System.assert(icon.hashCode() != 0); System.assert(icon.toString().contains('Custom42')); System.assertEquals('image/svg+xml', icon.getContentType()); System.assertEquals('Custom42: Treasure chest', icon.getTheme()); System.assert(icon.getUrl().contains('widget')); System.assertEquals(0, icon.getHeight()); System.assertEquals(0, icon.getWidth()); System.assertEquals(icon.getContentType(), icon.contentType); System.assertEquals(icon.getHeight(), icon.height); System.assertEquals(icon.getTheme(), icon.theme); System.assertEquals(icon.getUrl(), icon.url); System.assertEquals(icon.getWidth(), icon.width);
